detours.limitation: Conservative two-sided witness: exact 20x20 sweeps, opposite half-planes through an actual triangle interior, forward-only axis projection, and closed-loop winding ±1. A failed witness is not a proof no alternative bypass exists; no player-preference claim.

definitions.solidDistance: Euclidean distance to union of original nondegenerate solid XY triangles; relief/VOID/groundEdge excluded; BVH bounds only accelerate exact triangle distance.
definitions.voidDistance: Euclidean distance to actual authoritative 8px matter/VOID boundary segments; solid cells retain their terrain.
definitions.clearRadius: min(solidDistance, voidDistance), maximum over spawn-reachable full 20x20-body centres at 8px spacing. Empty-area diagnosis, never LOS or stealth coverage.
definitions.openComponents: Four-connected centre samples whose clearRadius exceeds the explicit threshold; sampled cell area is not exact continuous polygon area.
definitions.routes: Four-neighbour routes with exact continuous 20x20 sweeps. min*Distance/Radius are vertex samples; continuous-radius lower bound subtracts half the longest segment using the distance-field Lipschitz bound. No continuous shortest-path claim.
